entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,772 K and log g 2.54 (u1 0.444, u2 0.264): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
